subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should core permanently adopt the new opt-in agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs setting together with the synchronous command-queue onTaskTimeout fence contract?
rationale: The implementation is well tested, but repository policy does not allow automation to choose a new configuration surface or shared queue/cancellation contract, particularly when timeout release cannot terminate plugin-owned work.

options.title: Approve the opt-in contract
options.body: Land the current default-off configuration and queue callback contract, with the documented guarantee limited to releasing the lane and suppressing OpenClaw-owned late side effects.

options.title: Consolidate existing timeout primitives
options.body: Revise the PR to reuse an existing host compaction or abort/release contract without adding a separate configuration key or parallel queue callback API.

options.title: Pause the core change
options.body: Keep existing behavior until a cancellable context-engine maintenance contract is designed, leaving the linked session-stall issue unresolved meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Land the current default-off configuration and queue callback contract, with the documented guarantee limited to releasing the lane and suppressing OpenClaw-owned late side effects.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the major shared context-engine lifecycle implementation and is best positioned to decide its permanent timeout and cancellation semantics.
